clips.title: The story
paras: The Dead Acre lies burned and abandoned in southeastern Westfall, near the bridge to Duskwood. The Defias Brotherhood torched the farm during their uprising, and rogue harvest golems now stalk its blackened fields.

You find the Dead Acre just north of the road from Sentinel Hill to Duskwood. Once a productive homestead among Westfall’s breadbasket farms, it met a violent end when the Defias Brotherhood rose in revolt and drove out the local landowners. The farm and its crops went up in flames. Scorched timber and smoking earth remain, while mechanical Harvest Watchers still reap the barren soil.
